{
  "job_id": "DIRECTOR-FAILOVER-FULL-TEST-20260907",
  "department": "SCENE",
  "status": "REPAIR",
  "scene_decisions": {
    "identity_dependency": "Scene integration is conditional because the authoritative Inaria identity specification, reference version, and change log are missing from shared memory. Scene choices must not become identity signals or compensate for unresolved Character and Clothing decisions.",
    "locked_requirements": [
      "Preserve established Inaria identity, age presentation, body proportions, skin tone, hair identity, and recognizable facial markers across all scenes and failover routes.",
      "Scene must support Character, Clothing, Pose, Camera, and Prompt decisions without dominating the subject.",
      "Use believable scale, perspective, spatial relationships, object placement, and environmental continuity.",
      "Keep hands, feet, face, joints, and other anatomy-critical regions free of clutter and avoid accidental occlusion.",
      "Provide lighting sufficient for identity evaluation in core identity samples.",
      "Do not create production assets during this test."
    ],
    "adjustable_choices": [
      "Location type, season, weather, time of day, lighting direction, atmosphere, background materials, depth, and environmental objects may vary after upstream identity approval.",
      "Camera-facing background readability, subject-to-background contrast, and negative space may be adjusted to support pose and clothing evaluation.",
      "Environmental detail may be scaled down or simplified whenever it competes with facial identity, anatomy, garment construction, or hand and foot readability."
    ],
    "proposed_controlled_variation": [
      "Location: restrained indoor, residential, urban, natural, and transitional environments with believable context.",
      "Season: warm-weather, transitional, and cold-weather conditions coordinated with approved clothing variants.",
      "Weather: clear, overcast, light rain, or light snow only when visibility and anatomy readability remain stable.",
      "Time: daylight, soft golden-hour, and controlled evening settings; reserve low-light scenes for non-core identity samples.",
      "Lighting: vary direction and softness while maintaining visible facial structure, stable skin-tone interpretation, and readable garment surfaces.",
      "Background: rotate material, depth, and color families while preserving subject separation and avoiding repetitive identity-bearing landmarks.",
      "Composition: vary environmental context and camera distance without changing every scene variable simultaneously."
    ],
    "generation_stability": [
      "Use uncluttered backgrounds with controlled contrast behind the face, hands, feet, and silhouette.",
      "Avoid branches, railings, furniture edges, signage, poles, cables, crowds, reflective surfaces, and high-frequency patterns crossing anatomy-critical regions.",
      "Maintain consistent ground planes, horizon placement, contact shadows, perspective, and believable subject scale.",
      "Keep weather effects, haze, foliage, particles, and atmospheric effects subordinate to identity and anatomy evaluation.",
      "Ensure scene lighting does not create facial asymmetry, false hairline cues, merged limbs, floating feet, or ambiguous garment boundaries.",
      "Use explicit negative-space requirements around hands, feet, head, and major joints for pose and camera handoffs."
    ],
    "handoff_result": "SCENE can provide conditional environment variants and stability rules, but final Director integration, failover routing, diversity-gate validation, and QA traceability remain blocked until the canonical Inaria identity record and approved upstream versions are available."
  },
  "locked_constraints": [
    "Established Inaria identity must remain unchanged across all Director handoffs and failover routes.",
    "Scene, lighting, weather, background objects, and environmental landmarks must not become canonical identity traits.",
    "Face, hair identity, age presentation, body proportions, skin tone, anatomy, and recognizable markers take priority over environmental decoration.",
    "Core identity samples require lighting and background readability sufficient for identity evaluation.",
    "Scene must support clothing fit, pose readability, camera composition, and prompt intent without introducing occlusion or clutter.",
    "Believable scale, perspective, contact, object placement, and environmental continuity are required.",
    "Scene variation must be intentional, reversible, and controlled; do not change every variable at once.",
    "Anatomy and generation stability take priority over atmosphere and visual complexity.",
    "JSON-only department output is required.",
    "No production assets may be created during this test."
  ],
  "intentional_variations": [
    "Vary location, season, weather, time, lighting, atmosphere, background depth, and environmental materials in controlled combinations.",
    "Use distinct scene families to support dataset diversity without introducing recurring landmarks that could be mistaken for identity signals.",
    "Coordinate environmental temperature, lighting, and ground conditions with approved Clothing and Pose decisions.",
    "Reserve dramatic weather, low-key lighting, heavy haze, dense crowds, and high-contrast backgrounds for controlled non-core samples.",
    "Keep scene variants reversible and non-canonical unless explicitly approved and versioned.",
    "Preserve Character and Clothing locked_constraints and intentional_variations without mutation in every downstream handoff."
  ],
  "notes": [
    "Status is REPAIR because the approved Character and Clothing handoffs identify a blocking absence of the authoritative Inaria identity reference, reference version, and change log.",
    "The full integration test cannot be marked PASS, and failover routing cannot be fully validated, until the canonical identity record is available in shared GitHub memory.",
    "Scene-specific diversity gates, Director handoff parity, JSON-only routing checks, anatomy checks, generation-stability checks, and final QA traceability remain pending upstream repair.",
    "No production assets were created; this output is test-only."
